artifacts.notes: The issue identity pages and artifact pages 49-69, corresponding to printed pp. 367-387, were visually inspected. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The exact modern journal issue is publicly delivered by the responsible Holy See dicastery, but the issue contains modern editorial, typographic, liturgical, and scholarly material and no artifact-level redistribution license was located. Online official availability alone is not repository redistribution permission.

editors: Congregation for Divine Worship and the Discipline of the Sacraments
edition.notes: The official archive places this issue under Notitiae 44 (2008), and the following year's official retrospective cites the reprint notice as Notitiae 44 (2008), pp. 367-387. The issue masthead itself anomalously prints 'Vol. 45 (2008)'. This record preserves that discrepancy rather than silently treating the masthead as controlling.
edition.title: Notitiae, volume 44, numbers 503-504

work.description: The official periodical edited by the Holy See's competent liturgical dicastery. Issue editions and exact delivery artifacts remain container identities distinct from the documentary acts, notices, studies, and liturgical texts printed within them.
